body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Dell introduced its Warcraft gaming notebook pc 'XPS M1730' during CES 2008, which features Intel Core 2 Duo extreme X7900, 512MB(2X256MB) dual NVIDIA GeForce 8700M GT, AGEIA PhysX 100M Processor.
Boasting sleek appearance with various colors that you can choose from, the XPS M1730 adopts 17-inch wide LCD monitor supporting 7ms response time(gray-to-gray)and full size backlit keyboard.
